findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant matching before granting document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` instead of rejecting the request. Any caller relying on this predicate can consequently expose documents across tenant boundaries.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant matching before granting document reads
findings.body:
Any caller passing different `userTenant` and `documentTenant` values now receives `true`, bypassing tenant isolation and allowing cross-tenant document access.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant comparison before granting document reads
findings.body:
The predicate now authorizes every request. Whenever `userTenant !== documentTenant`, callers relying on this function permit cross-tenant document access, bypassing tenant isolation and exposing another tenant’s data.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
